name: NavyAI
description: One key across a broad model catalogue, with a permanent daily token allowance.
overview: NavyAI is a unified OpenAI-compatible gateway whose Free plan publishes 150,000 tokens per day and 20 requests per minute with no charge and no card. Sign-in is through Discord, models are discovered through /v1/models, and the free pool covers a rotating selection of open models — Llama 3.3 70B, Gemma 4 31B and DeepSeek V4 Flash among them — while newer paid routes stay restricted to higher plans.
notes: Free pool rotates with the catalogue; paid routes are gated behind higher plans.
